## Before Filing

Do not post private exploit details, secrets, tokens, private data, or sensitive reproduction material in a public issue. Follow `SECURITY.md` for private reporting.

## Concern

What boundary may be unclear or unsafe?

## Affected Surface

- [ ] Validation
- [ ] Scanner
- [ ] Export
- [ ] MCP
- [ ] Draft Intake or activation
- [ ] Backup or restore
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other:

## Expected Boundary

What should remain local-first, data-only, non-executable, or review-gated?
